overall_notes: The paper is well-aligned with NLG evaluation research. It generates dialogues using multiple LLMs and evaluates them using both human annotations and LLM-as-judge approaches. The CHAST metrics provide a novel framework for evaluating subtle harms. The extraction was generally good but needed normalization of metric names and cleaning up of implementation details.
